item.title: British Airways crew hospitalised after passenger gives them marijuana-laced sweets
item.description: Three British Airways cabin crew members were hospitalised after unknowingly consuming marijuana-infused sweets given by a passenger following a flight to Los Angeles. A replacement crew operated the return flight. The airline has launched an investigation into the incident.

item.title: Emptied lava tube discovered on Venus
item.description: For the first time, scientists have discovered an empty lava tube on Venus. Such structures are found on Earth, Mars and the Moon.

item.title: ‘Power-sharing won’t work in Tamil Nadu’: MK Stalin’s firm stand amid DMK-Congress alliance talks
item.description: Tamil Nadu Election 2026 : Stalin’s pre-emptive clarification on power sharing appears to be a strategic move to set the negotiation framework, ensuring that the upcoming discussions are focused solely on seat allocation and not on executive authority.

item.title: Facebook launches Meta AI-powered profile picture animation and animated text posts
item.description: Facebook has introduced new Meta AI-powered features that let users animate their profile pictures and add motion effects like waves, confetti, and party hats. Users can also restyle Stories and Memories using AI prompts, preset styles, moods, lighting effects, and themed backdrops.

item.title: Hubble captures dying star in unprecedented detail
item.description: Hubble has captured the most detailed view of the Egg Nebula, which is a star in its death throes. The observations provide the clearest picture yet of the final stages of a star’s life.

item.title: Bangladesh Elections 2026: What’s the voting schedule and how it works
item.description: Bangladesh is set for its crucial parliamentary elections on February 12, the first since former PM Sheikh Hasina’s ouster. With 127 million eligible voters and over 2,000 candidates vying for 299 seats, the polls will shape the nation’s future. New postal voting allows overseas workers to participate, and results may take longer due to a referendum on structural reforms.
